verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a drop-in OpenAI-compatible endpoint: set base_url, api_key and model, and existing OpenAI SDK code works unchanged. That implies it can plug into any agent or framework that accepts a custom OpenAI base URL. However, the evidence shows no first-party guides for specific coding agents or agent frameworks, and probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: named first-party integration guides for coding agents (e.g., IDE/CLI agents), guides for agent frameworks, machine-readable docs or an OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent integrations.
